newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola sees gain from sale of stake.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola sees gain from sale of stake.

text.p: Coca-Cola Co said it completed the sale of its 49 percent interest in the operations of Coca-Cola & Schweppes Beverages Ltd to Coca-Cola Enterprises Inc, resulting in an after-tax gain of about $0.08 per share for Coca-Cola Co.
The gain will be recorded in the first quarter of 1997 and will fully contribute to both first quarter and full year results, Coca-Cola said.
Coca-Cola said the sale will also result in gross proceeds of about $1 billion. The company expects to utilize the cash proceeds from the sale primarily to reduce short-term debt.
Separately, Coca-Cola Enterprises completed the purchase of the 51 percent interest in the operations of Coca-Cola/Schweppes currently held by Cadbury Schweppes Plc.
Coca-Cola Enterprises will become the sole bottler of products of Coca-Cola Co and of Cadbury Schweppes in Great Britain.
